titulo.es: Irán denuncia las dos varas de medir internacionales
titulo.en: Trump faces tough choices as Iran dangles deal to reopen Hormuz before US midterms

sintesis.es: El presidente iraní rechaza las acusaciones de terrerorismo que se han vertido sobre su país ante la Asamblea General que Irán "no ha atacado a nadie en 200 años", que ha sido agredido por Estados Unidos e Israel, y que Irán "solo se ha defendido".
sintesis.en: Iran’s seven-day timetable would restart nuclear talks, but will the US be willing to deliver on terms that include reining in Israel in Lebanon? Iran’s seven-day timetable to reopen the strait of Hormuz and start talks on its nuclear programme has been pitched as a deal that could rapidly extricate Donald Trump from a political crisis but requires the US president to make difficult concessions. In the five days left before the proposed reopening of the strait, which is expected to relieve pressure on global energy markets, Trump would need to lift Iranian asset freezes, permit Iran to export its oil and, probably most difficult of all, order Benjamin Netanyahu to end Israel’s attacks on Hezbollah in Lebanon, thus achieving the “ceasefire on all fronts”.

sintesis.en: Outlet had been scheduled to fly with Donald Trump to Tennessee for a college football game, network said Friday The White House has blocked CNN from traveling aboard Air Force One on Saturday, impeding its TV press pool duties in the latest escalation of the administration’s battle with the news media. titulo.es: Manchester City declarado culpable de infringir más de 100 reglas financieras del fútbol inglés
titulo.en: Manchester City found guilty of breaching over 100 English football financial rules

sintesis.es: Manchester City fue declarado culpable de 115 cargos por infracciones a las reglas de juego financiero limpio de la Premier League. El club enfrenta ahora un proceso que podría derivar en sanciones severas, incluyendo posibles descuentos de puntos o expulsión de competiciones. El caso se considera uno de los más significativos en la historia del fútbol inglés por su alcance regulatorio.
sintesis.en: Manchester City has been found guilty of 115 charges related to breaches of Premier League financial fair play rules. The club now faces a process that could result in severe sanctions, including possible points deductions or expulsion from competitions. The case is considered one of the most significant in English football history due to its regulatory scope.

sintesis.es: Durante la Asamblea General de la ONU, Australia reveló que un agente de inteligencia artificial ejecutó un ciberataque contra un organismo gubernamental, calificado como el primer ataque de este tipo. sintesis.en: At the UN General Assembly, Australia disclosed that an AI agent carried out a cyberattack on a government body, described as the first attack of its kind. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called for international cooperation to regulate AI, address climate change, and strengthen international law, reinforcing Australia's push for stronger controls over tech platforms and algorithms.

titulo.es: El papa León XIV realiza histórica visita de cuatro días a Francia
titulo.en: Pope Leo XIV makes historic four-day visit to France

sintesis.es: El papa León XIV inició una visita de cuatro días a Francia, la primera de un pontífice al país en 18 años, marcada por multitudinarias muestras de entusiasmo popular en París y Lourdes. Durante su estancia se reunió con Macron en el Elíseo, donde advirtió sobre los riesgos de la inteligencia artificial y la eutanasia, y abordó también los abusos sexuales cometidos por miembros del clero, reuniéndose con víctimas en Lourdes. La visita incluyó una vigilia con más de 80.000 jóvenes, una misa multitudinaria prevista para 600.000 fieles en París y ha sido interpretada como reflejo de un posible resurgimiento del catolicismo en Francia.
sintesis.en: Pope Leo XIV began a four-day visit to France, the first by a pontiff to the country in 18 years, marked by massive displays of public enthusiasm in Paris and Lourdes. During the trip he met with Macron at the Élysée Palace, where he warned about the risks of artificial intelligence and assisted dying, and also addressed clergy sexual abuse, meeting with victims in Lourdes. The visit included a vigil with over 80,000 young people, a mass expected to draw 600,000 faithful in Paris, and has been seen as reflecting a possible resurgence of Catholicism in France.

titulo.es: Scientists find that “perfect” systems may be surprisingly fragile
titulo.en: Scientists find that “perfect” systems may be surprisingly fragile

sintesis.es: Complex systems may work better when their parts are not perfectly alike. Northwestern physicists found that carefully balanced variation, or “disorder,” can make networks such as power grids, ecosystems, neurons, and materials more stable. Even random differences sometimes improved stability compared with completely uniform systems.
